notes.title: Character Voices Added with Support from the Agency for Cultural Affairs
notes.notes:
Being selected for the Agency for Cultural Affairs’ Media Arts Creator Support Program enabled CultureHouse to carry out full Japanese voice recording.
[previewyoutube=op9wZg13dqo;full][/previewyoutube]

We commissioned Aoni Production, Japan’s most established voice actor agency, for the recording. Across two days and over 15 hours of studio time, voices were recorded for six characters, based on a 48,000-character script.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44422793/62bc51b1d7536ed0059fb2135d3677c55f63c420.jpg[/img]

In February 2025, a demo featuring character voices was exhibited at 'ENCOUNTERS,' the results showcase event for the Agency for Cultural Affairs’ Media Arts Creator Development Program. Many attendees had the opportunity to experience the game on a large screen in an art space setting.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44422793/3924f366a2e33d2813a29bd4fd57ed62582e6f0e.jpg[/img]

CultureHouse remains committed to creating games that explore and express their artistic potential.

notes.title: TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2024
notes.notes:
A playable demo of CultureHouse will be exhibited at TOKYO INDIE GAMES SUMMIT 2024, which will be held in Kichijoji, Tokyo on March 2nd (Business Day) and 3rd (Public Day).

notes.title: Exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2023!
notes.notes:
"CultureHouse" was exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2023, held at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, Japan, from September 21 to 24. In the indie game corner, we set up a test play area in the "Selected Indie 80" area, a free exhibition project, and in the Kodansha Game Creators' Lab booth, where many game fans enjoyed playing our games.

The Facility Guide vol. 1 was distributed at the venue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44422793/849e87e0a1677051beec991416b4f3fe96e3be15.jpg[/img].

The work was also featured in the media independently.

2023-09-28 [url=https://www.4gamer.net/games/726/G072646/20230923025/]Featured by IGN Japan! [/url]
2023-09-24 [url=https://www.indie-freaks.com/2023/09/tgs2023-culturehouse/]Featured in Indie Freaks! [/url]
2023-09-23 [url=https://www.4gamer.net/games/726/G072646/20230923025/]Featured on 4Gamer! [/url]

Thank you to everyone who came out and visited us.

notes.title: CultureHouse will be featured at Selected Indie Games 80 ~Gateway to SOWN2023~
notes.notes:
CultureHouse has been selected as one of the indie game selection slots [b]Selected Indie 80[/b] at Tokyo Game Show 2023, which will be held from September 21st to 24th.
Along with this, CultureHouse will also appear in Selected Indie 80's introductory program [b]Gateway to SOWN2023[/b], which will be broadcast on August 29th.

[previewyoutube=ZmBjI4ym45U;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3][/h3]
At the same time as the release of the program, PS5 and Nintendo Switch will win [url=https://tgs.nikkeibp.co.jp/tgs/2023/en/program/indie/campaign/]Predict SOWN2023 Finalists Campaign[/url] is held. If you are interested, please check here.

notes.title: Yokohama Game Dungeon
notes.notes:
On August 27, 2023, CultureHouse will be exhibited at the Yokohama Game Dungeon held at Yokohama Digital Arts College, a 7-minute walk from Shin-Yokohama Station.
https://tokyogamedungeon.com/


In the demo that will be exhibited this time, we plan to add a photography function that allows you to take snapshots of the sky and lighting that change depending on the time of day and the Polaroid camera style of the 70's.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44422793/9a1045bbc92488abba1de1b61533dabcf5154d9a.png[/img]
CultureHouse's exhibition is C-12 on the right back of the 3rd floor.
Admission is free, so please come and visit us.
https://tokyogamedungeon.com/yokohama/exhibitor_yokohama_02/


A one-minute trailer will also be shown on the screen at the venue.
[previewyoutube=QNWT0Hhqz9M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Tokyo Game Dungeon 3
notes.notes:
CultureHouse will be exhibited at the indie game exhibition [b] "Tokyo Game Dungeon 3"[/b] to be held on July 30, 2023 at the Tokyo Metropolitan Industry and Trade Center Hamamatsucho-kan in Hamamatsucho.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44422793/f0e40f865533a6e8dfecba33d1be1ab47ad30542.png[/img]
